entries.content_plain:
Introduction

 Solomon's buildings, conquests, and officers, 2Chr 8:1-10 . He brings Pharaoh's daughter to his new-built palace, 2Chr 8:11 . His various sacrifices, and arrangement of the priests, Levites, and porters, 2Chr 8:12-16 . He sends a fleet to Ophir, 2Chr 8:17 , 2Chr 8:18 . 

 Verse 1 

 At the end of twenty years - He employed seven years and a half in building the temple, and twelve and a half, or thirteen, in building his own house. - Compare this with 1Kgs 7:1 .

entries.content_osis: <hi type="bold">Verse 18</hi> <div eID="gen14075" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen14076" type="x-p"/> Knowledge of the sea - Skilful sailors. Solomon probably bore the expenses and his friend, the Tyrian king, furnished him with expert sailors; for the Jews, at no period of their history, had any skill in maritime affairs, their navigation being confined to the lakes of their own country, from which they could never acquire any nautical skill. The Tyrians, on the contrary, lived on and in the sea.  <chapter eID="2Chr.8"/> <div eID="gen14076" type="x-p"/>
